sloka: सप्त जाति शतानि एव मृतपाः सन्तु सर्वशः ।श्व मांस नियत आहारा मुष्टिका नाम निर्घृणाः ॥१-५९-१९॥
transliteration: sapta jāti śatāni eva mṛtapāḥ santu sarvaśaḥ ।śva māṁsa niyata āhārā muṣṭikā nāma nirghṛṇāḥ ॥1-59-19॥

translations.english: Reborn as the merciless race of mushtikas, feeding on the flesh of dogs, hideous and deformed, they shall wander in these worlds.
